name: Side Neck Stretch
instructions: Start with your shoulders relaxed, gently tilt your head towards your shoulder.
Assist stretch with a gentle pull on the side of the head.

name: Bodyweight Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
Sit back and down until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
Drive through your heels to stand. Repeat for 10 to 20 repetitions.

name: Star Jump
instructions: Stand with your feet together and arms at your sides.
Jump, spreading arms and legs into a star.
Land softly with feet together and repeat.

name: Chair Upper Body Stretch
instructions: Sit on the edge of a chair and clasp your hands behind it.
Straighten your arms and lift your chest. Hold for 20 seconds.

name: Hammer Curls
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your torso.
Curl the weights up while keeping your upper arms still.
Lower slowly and repeat.

name: Kettlebell Windmill
instructions: Press a kettlebell overhead with one arm.
Push your hip out and lower your free hand towards your foot.
Return to standing and repeat.

name: Band Pull Apart
instructions: Hold a band in front of you at shoulder height.
Pull the band apart until it touches your chest.
Return slowly and repeat.

name: Plank
instructions: Get into a prone position on the floor, supporting your weight on your toes and forearms.
Keep your body straight and hold for 60 seconds.

name: Arm Circles
instructions: Stand with your arms held out to the sides.
Make small circles with your arms, then reverse.

name: Calf Stretch Hands Against Wall
instructions: Stand facing a wall with your hands on it.
Step one foot back and press the heel down.

name: Bench Dips
instructions: Place a bench behind you and put your hands on its edge.
Lower your body by bending your elbows, then press back up.

name: Leg Extensions
instructions: Sit on the machine with your legs under the pad.
Extend your legs to the maximum, then lower.

name: Barbell Squat
instructions: Set the bar on a rack just below shoulder level.
Squat down and stand back up.
